faq.intro: Find answers to commonly asked questions about AlphaFit AI

trackWorkouts.question: How do I track my workouts?
trackWorkouts.answer: You can track your workouts by going to the Workouts tab and selecting your desired workout plan. Follow the exercises and mark them as complete as you go.

customizeMeals.question: Can I customize my meal plans?
customizeMeals.answer: Yes! Navigate to the Diet tab and use the Smart Diet Plan feature. You can scan foods, set your dietary preferences, and our AI will generate personalized meal plans for you.

physiqueProjection.question: How does the AI Physique Projection work?
physiqueProjection.answer: Our AI analyzes your current photos and profile data (age, fitness level, goals) to project how your physique could transform over time with consistent training and nutrition.

proFeatures.question: What features are included in the Pro plan?
proFeatures.answer: Pro plan includes: unlimited AI-generated workouts, advanced physique projections, personalized meal plans, progress analytics, priority support, and ad-free experience.

cancelSubscription.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancelSubscription.answer: You can manage your subscription in your device settings under Subscriptions, or contact our support team at {{email}} for assistance.

dataSecurity.question: Is my data secure and private?
dataSecurity.answer: Absolutely! We use bank-level encryption to protect your data. Your photos, progress, and personal information are stored securely and never shared with third parties without your consent.

syncDevices.question: Can I sync data across devices?
syncDevices.answer: Yes, your data automatically syncs across all devices when you're logged in with the same account.

bodyScanAccuracy.question: How accurate is the body scan feature?
bodyScanAccuracy.answer: Our AI body scan uses advanced computer vision models trained on thousands of physiques. While highly accurate, results are estimates and should be used as guidance alongside professional advice.

reportBug.question: What should I do if I encounter a bug?
reportBug.answer: Please contact our support team at {{email}} with details about the issue. Include screenshots if possible, and we'll work quickly to resolve it.

changeGoals.question: Can I change my fitness goals after setup?
changeGoals.answer: Yes! You can update your goals, preferences, and profile information anytime from the Profile tab > Account Details.
